title: HumanAIOS Constitution — 22 Principles
description: Governance principles for decision validation, drift detection, and artifact grounding.

principles.name: Admit the gap
principles.construct: IC filing — naming error without minimization

principles.name: Restored state exists
principles.construct: REGISTERED.md as canonical truth

principles.name: No unverified claims
principles.construct: ACAT Phase 1 unanchored self-assessment

principles.name: Public record of sessions
principles.construct: WGS session close — visible record

principles.name: Primary purpose filter
principles.construct: Work only if: generates data, tests hypothesis, or generates revenue

principles.name: Attraction not promotion (T11)
principles.construct: No CTAs; URL only; Wu Wei in practice

principles.name: Research before commerce (T12 variant)
principles.construct: Open research publication before any commercial use

principles.name: Detection beats compliance
principles.construct: Name drift before justifying it; P19 filter active

principles.name: Principles over personalities
principles.construct: Collaborator data never public without prior self-attribution

principles.name: Overconfidence flag
principles.construct: No confidence > 0.95 without counter-evidence

principles.name: Below Courage (200): STOP
principles.construct: Below Courage (200): do not decide, do not post, transfer chat

principles.name: Zone discipline governs
principles.construct: Z3 gate — not executing what belongs to Night (Z2)

principles.name: Research integrity (no funder shaping)
principles.construct: No funder shapes findings

principles.name: TRL framing (no overclaims)
principles.axis: T10 — No opinion on outside issues
principles.construct: TRL 2–3 framing; no overclaims; 'being developed as' not 'is'

principles.name: Corpus integrity
principles.construct: Single violated row threatens whole dataset

principles.name: Decision transparency
principles.construct: Major decisions logged + Zone-gated appropriately

principles.name: Log full artifact spectrum
principles.construct: findings + unknowns + assumptions + decisions + dead_ends + mistakes logged

principles.name: The graph is the artifact
principles.construct: Artifacts connected with meaningful relations (not isolated orphans)

principles.name: Commit per task
principles.construct: Atomic commits after each work unit; no batching to end

principles.name: Ack completed work
principles.construct: Completion handshake for peer requests; no silent accept-and-forgot

principles.name: Pull when uncertain
principles.construct: Collab the swarm before guessing in isolation

principles.name: Share canonical sources
principles.construct: Register sources at --visibility shared so peers reference
